description: This file defines API endpoints for managing notes in a note-organizing application using FastAPI. It includes functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, soft deleting, archiving, restoring, and pinning notes. The file utilizes SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions and employs conventions like title prefixes to represent states such as archived, trashed, or pinned.

methods.name: _apply_note_filters( stmt, search: Optional[str], tag: Optional[str], pinned: Optional[bool], archived: Optional[bool], trashed: Optional[bool], )
methods.description: Internal utility to apply search and filter criteria to a SQLAlchemy select statement based on optional parameters like search term, tags, and tags representing note states via title prefixes.

methods.name: List[NoteRead] list_notes( search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Free text search in title/content"), tag: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by tag name"), pinned: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by pinned state"), archived: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by archived state"), trashed: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by trashed state"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a list of notes with optional filtering by search text, tag name, and note states (pinned, archived, trashed).

methods.name: NoteRead get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve a single note by its ID, raising a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: List[Tag] _resolve_tags_by_ids(db: Session, tag_ids: Optional[List[int]])
methods.description: Helper function to fetch Tag objects by their IDs, validating existence.

methods.name: NoteRead create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Create a new note with optional associated tags.

methods.name: NoteRead update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Update an existing note's title, content, and tags.

methods.name: None soft_delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Soft delete a note by prefixing its title with '[TRASH]', following conventions without altering schema.

methods.name: str _ensure_no_duplicate_prefix(title: str, prefix: str)
methods.description: Utility to add a prefix to a title while ensuring no duplicates of conflicting prefixes.

methods.name: NoteRead archive_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Archive a note by prefixing its title with '[ARCHIVED]'. Removes prior conflicting prefixes.

methods.name: NoteRead restore_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Restore a note by removing state prefixes from its title.

methods.name: NoteRead pin_toggle_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Toggle the pinned state of a note by adding or removing the '[PIN]' prefix in its title.
